meta.name: archify
meta.description: Create polished, validated architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle/state diagrams as explorable standalone HTML with inline SVG, dark/light themes, optional trace motion, and PNG/JPEG/WebP/SVG/WebM export. Accept plain-language requirements or pasted Mermaid flowchart, sequenceDiagram, and stateDiagram input; inspect repository evidence when the diagram must reflect real code. Use when the user asks to visualize system architecture, infrastructure, cloud/security/network topology, technical workflows, API call sequences, request lifecycles, data pipelines, ETL/ELT, data lineage, state machines, or to convert/beautify Mermaid.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把系统结构与流程变成清晰直观的图表
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 需要把系统结构画出来给团队评审或留档。
copy.tagline_en: Turn system structures and flows into clear diagrams
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to visualize system structure for team review or documentation.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把你用大白话描述的系统架构、流程、API 调用时序、数据管道或状态机，做成一份可交互的独立 HTML 图（内联 SVG、明暗主题），并可导出 PNG、SVG、WebM 等格式。
howto.when: 当你要求把系统架构、API 调用时序、数据管道等画成图，或想转换、美化 Mermaid 的 flowchart、sequenceDiagram 等输入时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个订单系统的架构画成一张图
say.note: 产出一份可交互的独立 HTML 图。

say.text: 把这段 Mermaid sequenceDiagram 转成 Archify 图
say.note: 只取拓扑与含义，不照搬 Mermaid 样式。

say.text: 把这个部署拓扑导出成 PNG

howto.what_en: After install, Claude turns your description of an architecture, workflow, API call sequence, data pipeline, or state machine into a standalone interactive HTML diagram with inline SVG, light/dark themes, and PNG/JPEG/SVG/WebM export.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to visualize system architecture, API call sequences, data pipelines, etc., or to convert or beautify Mermaid flowchart, sequenceDiagram, or stateDiagram input.

say_en.text: Draw this order system's architecture as a diagram
say_en.note: Produces a standalone interactive HTML diagram.

say_en.text: Convert this pasted Mermaid sequenceDiagram into an Archify diagram
say_en.note: Topology and meaning kept; Mermaid styling not copied.

say_en.text: Export this deployment topology as a PNG
say_en.note: PNG, WebP, SVG and other exports supported.
